provenance.pipelineSource: June 23, 2026 lab report covering the first six reported visits. Full preprocessing parameters are not documented here.
provenance.measure: Share of reported SGB abundance weights; each supplied weight divided by the sum across all reported stool SGBs for that visit. Underlying integer units are unverified; these are not asserted to be raw reads, cells, or absolute microbial load.
provenance.validation: First visit matches original lab CSV. Normalized weights reproduce all five lab-report Shannon and inverse-Simpson values at two decimals.
provenance.missing: An absent SGB row is treated as not detected (zero in the supplied profile), not proven biological absence.
provenance.scope: Five stool profiles in the downloadable public summary. Later archive collections have not been imported. No tumor matching, external reference, p-values or clinical scoring.
